summary: Carry current B12X master into beta: A16 token cutoffs, job-scoped preparation reuse, safe rejection of oversized cooperative launches
compatibility: No user action required. The first start after updating compiles and tunes the changed kernels again: in our tests GLM-5.3-Flash Spark TP2 started about 5 minutes and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next TP2 about 11 minutes later than with a warm cache; later starts are fast again. The new a16_max_tokens planning constraint defaults to zero, so configured precisions are unchanged unless a caller sets it.
details: Planning accepts an inclusive a16_max_tokens cutoff for dense and MoE execution and prepares an A16 capacity below it.
Preparation shares immutable launch bundles within a job, releases composite plans in batches and reclaims unused programs after teardown.
The beta-only paged_decode and small-row block-FP8 GEMV compile factories (MiMo-V2.6) use the same job-scoped reuse as every other factory.
Autotuning drains and releases cooperative launch trials rejected with CUDA error 720 instead of failing, and does not cache incomplete coverage.
W4A16 fallback activation-amax scales are flattened for parameter-backed global scales.
DSA compile workers keep fake-tensor indexing off CUDA (#390).
